# L1 — B001: capability contracts, module manifests, workflow-read facets, code-reviewer agent

@@ output/template/.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md ;; Agent definition (delegated reviewer; preloads code-review).
@scope code-reviewer agent (on delegation)
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter (name, description, preloaded code-review skill).
5 OL [wf010.reviewer-readonly]
6 IM ;; Frontmatter end.
8 NN ;; Banner.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [wf010.reviewer-readonly,wf010.reviewer-canonical]
14 OL [wf001.reviewer-read-rules,wf007.reviewer-scan-when]
16 OL [wf012.reviewer-output]

C wf010.reviewer-readonly OL WF-010 MUST_NOT ;; Independent read-only review: never edit files; Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit are disallowed (shell tools are not). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf010.reviewer-canonical OL WF-010 MUST ;; Use the code-review skill as the canonical procedure (load it first) and follow its scope, priorities and output instead of redefining criteria. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.reviewer-read-rules OL WF-001 MUST ;; Read the rule files governing the changed paths before judging; the subagent context does not inherit loaded rules. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.reviewer-scan-when OL WF-007,WF-020 MUST ;; Run the full security-scan only on request, for materially security-sensitive changes or when a concrete finding justifies it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf012.reviewer-output OL WF-012,WF-010 MUST ;; Return findings ordered by severity, or an explicit no-findings statement plus areas that could not be verified. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.cap-frame-placement EX - MUST ;; The frame maps the role vocabulary to projects and owns placement; leaf slots depend on roles, not frame terms; placement belongs to the frame, technique to the leaf. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).
C x.cap-required-facets EX - ENFORCED ;; Each slot contract lists required facets (form, level, loading, content) that the selected module must provide; checked by check-instructions.mjs. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system invariant (repo/meta).
C x.cap-frame-obligations EX - MUST ;; The frame expresses every role in roles.md without contradicting role-level rules, keeps leaf technology out of frame facets, and leaf bindings not expressible through roles are declared as binds in the leaf manifest. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).
C x.cap-replacement-complete EX ARC-020 MUST ;; A replacement module supplies every required facet, updates the selection record (and the CLAUDE.md import of a style/stack facet) and passes check-instructions.mjs; workflows refer only to slot facets. ;; = ;; Module replacement. ;; Capability replacement procedure (repo/meta).

C arc027.layout-real-code OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Create only directories that contain real code (e.g. Middleware only when custom middleware exists); trees are targets, not checklists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc005.layout-ddd-dirs OL ARC-005,ARC-004 MUST_NOT ;; ValueObjects/DomainServices/Events/Exceptions only when an approved design needs them; business rules alone do not justify DDD directories. ;; = ;; Approved design. ;;
C x.layout-folder-roles EX ARC-027,DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Folder roles: Application Abstractions/Persistence (no persistence-implementation types), Abstractions/ExternalServices (only once dependencies exist), Services, DTOs (not a dumping ground), Validation; Infrastructure Persistence/{Configurations,Repositories,Migrations,Seeding}, Services; Api entry-point folder, Contracts/Requests|Responses, Middleware, Extensions. ;; = ;; Only when needed. ;; Layout convention not in the oracle.
C arc023.layout-app-di OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; AddApplication() registers Application services and validation only. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.layout-type-roles EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Supporting-type roles clear from name/directory using suffixes (Service, Dto, Request/Response — HTTP contracts in Api, Result/Outcome, Validator, Rules/Policy, Factory, Mapper, Adapter); prefer unambiguous names; responsibility subdirectories only for many heterogeneous types. ;; = ;; none ;; Naming heuristics not in the oracle.
C arc027.layout-no-buckets OL ARC-027 AVOID ;; Avoid generic Models/Helpers/Common/Utils buckets. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.layout-infra-di OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; AddInfrastructure(configuration) registers persistence, repositories, the commit boundary, adapters, outbound HTTP integrations and resilience handlers when used. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.layout-services-subdirs EX ARC-027 DEFAULT ;; Create capability-specific subdirectories under Infrastructure Services/ when they improve cohesion. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.layout-program-extensions EX ARC-012 MUST_NOT ;; Extensions/ holds cohesive composition extensions, not code moved merely to shorten Program.cs. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C arc012.layout-composition OL ARC-012,ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Program.cs calls AddApplication() and AddInfrastructure(configuration). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.layout-ref-graph OL ARC-001 MUST ;; Reference graph: Domain none; Application→Domain; Infrastructure→Application, Domain; Api→Application, Infrastructure; never Domain→Application/Infrastructure or Application→Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc028.layout-test-projects OL ARC-028,ARC-027 DEFAULT ;; Test projects and typical references: Application.Tests (use-case behaviour; Application + Domain), IntegrationTests (through the host; Api), optional Domain.Tests (non-trivial Domain; Domain), optional Infrastructure.Tests (non-trivial Infrastructure; narrower as required). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.layout-no-domain-tests OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; A simple Domain of entities and enums needs no dedicated test project. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.layout-frontend-tests OL DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Frontend tests stay inside the frontend workspace. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.cap-declared-properties EX GOV-006,PST-010 MUST ;; The selection record declares provider variant, default string-comparison/case-sensitivity semantics, migration mechanism and seeding mechanism for the persistence slot. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).
C x.cap-binds-required EX - MUST ;; The selected persistence module declares binds to the selected frame because its commands name frame projects. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).
C x.cap-conformance-decision EX GOV-017 MUST ;; A missing required facet is a conformance failure: raise a Decision Request instead of shipping the module. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.cap-replacement-semantics EX PST-005,PST-006,PST-010 MUST_NOT ;; Replacing the persistence implementation must not silently lose migration or seeding semantics; the new module states its mechanisms explicitly. ;; = ;; Implementation replacement. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.cap-provider-variant EX DEP-009,ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A database-provider change is a Reserved variation inside the persistence slot requiring updates to declared properties, dev-config, relational-fidelity binding and commands. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov006.provider-collation OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Observable string-comparison changes from a provider change need approval. ;; = ;; none ;;

C dep006.cmd-via-add-dependency OL DEP-003,DEP-004,DEP-006 MUST ;; Install packages only through add-dependency (latest stable compatible version; NuGet versions in Directory.Packages.props). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-scaffold-packages EX DEP-009,DEP-006 DEFAULT ;; Scaffold package placement: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer in Infrastructure, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design in the Api startup project, dotnet-ef via a tool manifest. ;; = ;; none ;; Package placement not in the oracle.

C wf019.cmd-no-prod OL WF-019 MUST_NOT ;; Never point database update/drop commands at Production; production migration is a deployment step. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/capabilities/persistence/ef-core/workflow.md ;; Workflow-read facet persistence.workflow (read by development-workflow, custom-settings, verify, code-review).
@scope workflow-read facet persistence.workflow (model/persistence changes, schema-affecting settings)
1 NN ;; Banner.
3 NN ;; Heading.
5 OL [wf001.pw-read-rules]
7 NN ;; Heading.
9 EX [x.pw-update-configs]
10 OL [pst008.pw-seed-cochange]
11 EX [x.pw-migration-project]
12 OL [pst010.pw-review]
13 OL [pst008.pw-seed-with-migration,pst006.pw-no-patch]
15 NN ;; Heading.
17-22 OL [pst009.pw-schema-settings]
24 NN ;; Heading.
26 EX [x.pw-verify-migrations]
27 EX [x.pw-verify-seed]
28 OL [wf019.pw-explicit-deploy]
30 NN ;; Heading.
32 EX [x.pw-report]

C wf001.pw-read-rules OL WF-001 MUST ;; Read persistence access and seeding rules first when they have not loaded. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.pw-update-configs EX ARC-019 MUST ;; Update affected entity configurations (IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>) and repository implementations for a model change. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C pst008.pw-seed-cochange OL PST-008 MUST ;; Whenever model/persistence changes affect seeded entities (properties, relationships, required related entities, enum/status values, states, invariants) update DbSeeder in the same change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.pw-migration-project EX ARC-019 DEFAULT ;; When the schema changes add a migration from the implementation-layer project with the entry-point project as startup project. ;; = ;; Schema changes. ;; Migration command technique not in the oracle.
C pst010.pw-review OL PST-010 MUST ;; Review every generated migration before committing (destructive changes, column recreation, data migrations, indexes, FKs, delete behaviour). ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.pw-seed-with-migration OL PST-008,PST-001 MUST ;; Review DbSeeder with migrations changing seeded entities; recreating an empty Development database must yield valid seed data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst006.pw-no-patch OL PST-006 MUST_NOT ;; Migrating an existing Development database does not require the seeder to patch existing rows. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst009.pw-schema-settings OL PST-009 MUST ;; For schema-affecting settings update the mapping, create a migration when needed (edit uncommitted ones only per the normal workflow; do not casually alter existing migrations), verify seeding, update provider-sensitive tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.pw-verify-migrations EX WF-005 MUST ;; Build the affected projects and list or script pending migrations to confirm the expected schema change. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.pw-verify-seed EX PST-005,WF-006 MUST ;; Apply migrations to a local Development database explicitly, start the API in Development and confirm the seeder populates an empty database or leaves an existing one unchanged. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf019.pw-explicit-deploy OL WF-019 MUST ;; Production schema changes stay an explicit deployment step (an idempotent script is often the better artifact). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.pw-report EX WF-009 MUST ;; Report model changes, migration names with review notes (destructive operations called out), whether DbSeeder was updated, and tests added/updated. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C dep014.cmd-scaffold OL DEP-014,DEP-024 MUST ;; Create the workspace at frontend/<Name>.Web/ with the current Angular CLI using the stack baseline (standalone, routing, SCSS, strict, zoneless when supported). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-confirm-cli-flags EX DEP-014 MUST ;; Confirm the exact flags of the installed CLI with ng new --help rather than from memory. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C dep014.cmd-cli-versions OL DEP-014,DEP-003 MUST_NOT ;; Let the CLI choose compatible TypeScript and RxJS versions; do not upgrade TypeScript beyond Angular's supported range independently. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.cmd-existing-scripts OL WF-018,WF-013 MUST_NOT ;; Inspect package.json before running anything; use scripts that exist and never invent script names. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf015.cmd-invalid-shortcuts OL WF-015,FE-001,DEP-015 MUST_NOT ;; Invalid repair shortcuts: converting to any, disabling strict mode, suppressing template diagnostics, adding NgModules for standalone problems, speculative API replacement, adding another state/HTTP library. ;; = ;; none ;;
